messages.author: c604b89d9c6ef07d
messages.subject: Re: error while running rhex()
parts:
Hi
The error you are getting is Caused by: java.io.IOException: Cannot

run program "/home/e106587/
R-2.13.0/library/Rhipe/libs/imperious.so": java.io.IOException:
error=2, No such file or directory

So i think the libraries are not properly linked. You can try adding
it to LD_LIBRARY_PATH and check.
